actions.create_contact.description: Creates a new contact in the system.
actions.create_contact.props.imageUrl.de: URL of the contact profile image.
actions.create_testimonial.description: Creates a new testimonial in the system.
actions.create_testimonial.props.externa: Embed HTML for an external video (e.g. YouTube or Vimeo embed code).
actions.create_testimonial.props.gaveCon: Whether the author gave consent to publish this testimonial.
actions.create_testimonial.props.imageUr: URL of the author profile image.
actions.create_testimonial.props.publish: Whether this testimonial is publicly visible.
actions.create_testimonial.props.title.d: The testimonial author's job title (e.g. CEO, Marketing Manager).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.props.contactId.d: The ID of the contact to delete.
actions.delete_testimonial.props.testimo: The ID of the testimonial to delete.
actions.find_contact.description: Finds a contact by ID or email address.
actions.find_contact.props.contactId.des: The ID of the contact to find. Provide either Contact ID or Email — ID takes priority.
actions.find_contact.props.email.descrip: Search for a contact by email address. Used only if Contact ID is not provided.
actions.find_testimonial.props.testimoni: The ID of the testimonial to retrieve.
actions.update_contact.description: Updates an existing contact in the system.
actions.update_contact.props.contactId.d: The ID of the contact to update.
actions.update_contact.props.email.descr: Required by the Trust API to identify the contact.
actions.update_testimonial.description: Updates an existing testimonial in the system.
actions.update_testimonial.props.email.d: Required by the Trust API to identify the testimonial.
actions.update_testimonial.props.testimo: The ID of the testimonial to update.
actions.upload_image.description: Uploads an image to the Trust media library.
actions.upload_image.props.file.descript: The image file to upload (JPEG, PNG, GIF, etc.).
actions.upload_small_video.description: Uploads a short video to the Trust media library.
actions.upload_small_video.props.file.de: The short video file to upload. Best suited for brief clips under 30 seconds.
actions.upload_video.description: Uploads a video to the Trust media library for use in testimonials.
actions.upload_video.props.file.descript: The video file to upload (MP4, MOV, AVI, etc.).
auth.description: Connect your Trust account using your Workspace ID and API key.
auth.props.api_key.description: Go to your Trust dashboard > Settings > API to generate an API key.
auth.props.workspace_id.description: Your Trust workspace ID. Find it in your Trust dashboard URL: https://app.usetrust.io/workspace/{workspaceId}/...
description: Collect and manage video and text testimonials from your customers.
triggers.new_testimonial.description: Triggers when a new testimonial is created in your Trust workspace.
